reviewer: runtime_audit, separate same-session agent from graph and authority implementers

findings.problem: Catalog admission initially accepted executed evidence from a previous delivery source revision.
findings.repair: Bind accepted packet to its source manifest and compare each executed file to current source; use final-source development baseline.

findings.problem: Membership proofs did not prove complete current class inventory, allowing duplicated unrelated revocation rows to hide the target revocation.
findings.repair: Rebuild complete typed forest and compare all records, proofs, roots and counts; reject duplicate leaves.

findings.problem: Current root context was self-selected and authorized root history was not checked.
findings.repair: Require caller anchored expected root, epoch and predecessor; validate complete authorized historical continuity separately from current technical authorization.

findings.problem: A root writer can remove declared dependencies and rewrite composition members while retaining unchanged attested dependencyDigests; selector admits only final delivery node.
findings.repair_requested: Recompute declared dependency identities from referenced skill bindings and bind composition to exact admitted member versions and implementation identities.

findings.problem: Uncommitted displayed scope, environment and rights can differ from authenticated context digests while selector reports successful reuse.
findings.repair_requested: Recompute descriptive scope/environment/rights digests against context and selected skill binding digests.

findings.problem: Public selectWorkflow consumes caller-owned records after proof checks. A genuine fixture verifier callback can mutate dependency and composition objects between proof verification and selection.
findings.repair_requested: Own immutable canonical catalog and context before callbacks, including public direct selection path.

findings.problem: Root authorizer uses raw context and attestation authorizer copies only shallowly; resolver callbacks can alter expected epoch or remove nested current revocations before enforcement.
findings.repair_requested: Deep-own canonical context before external callbacks; reject accessors.

findings.discovered_by: Creator self-critique before fresh outcomes; independent structural confirmation by runtime_audit
findings.problem: Initial registry comparator repeatedly scanned relationships while graph indexed adjacency, and both actually selected from requires. This created an avoidable weak-baseline penalty and failed to isolate graph-guided selection.
findings.repair: Registry uses ordinary retained validated composition recipe and evidence index. Graph selects through adjacency. Both use identical skills, evidence, policy and indexed validation; both examine4relationship rows.

no_finding: Generic graph snapshotDigest and signer authorityStateDigest legitimately bind separate material; equality is not a generic authority requirement.
Prepared createSelector already owns the catalog and resists caller mutation.

retained_inconclusive_artifact.reason: Probe ran during root repair against old catalog context without mandatory epoch/predecessor anchors; baseline failed. Negative results from that setup do not establish defenses.

limits: No live ENS registry or authorized signing was available. All authority tests use clearly labeled fixtures.
Review checks implementation boundaries and bounded attack cases; it is not exhaustive security certification.
Reviewer authored the separate production adapter; graph and authority code were implemented by other agents.
No primary pairwise or designed-root-stress production outcomes were inspected.

supplemental_admission_controls.outcome: Current catalog build rejects stale source and forged self-consistent certificates; independent final-source baseline replay passes.
